blocks.text: Kelajakda nima bo'lishini har doim ham aniq bilmaymiz. O'zbekchada bunday paytda «balki», «ehtimol» so'zlari yoki «-ishi mumkin», «-arman» shakllari ishlatiladi: «Balki Samarqandga borarman», «Ertaga yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin». Ingliz tilida buning eng oddiy yo'li — **might** modal fe'li: I **might** go to Samarkand. It **might** rain tomorrow. **might** gapga «aniq emas, bo'lishi ham, bo'lmasligi ham mumkin» degan ma'no qo'shadi.

rows: She **might not** come. — U kelmasligi mumkin.

blocks.text: **might** — modal fe'l, shuning uchun uning uchta qat'iy qoidasi bor. Birinchidan, barcha egalar bilan bir xil: I might, she **might** (`-s` qo'shilmaydi, «she mights» yo'q). Ikkinchidan, undan keyin fe'l `to` siz, oddiy shaklda keladi: might **go**, might **be** («might to go», «might going» emas). Uchinchidan, inkor va savolga `do` kerak emas: I **might not** go («I don't might» emas). Xuddi shu qoidalar will (28-dars), can, must va should ga ham tegishli (→ 30–32-darslar).

items.text: My uncle **might** sell his old car.
We **might** have dinner in town after the film.

blocks.text: **might** ko'pincha kelajak haqida: ertaga, keyingi hafta, kelasi yili nima bo'lishi mumkinligi. Lekin u **hozirgi** holat haqidagi taxminni ham bildiradi: Dilnoza **might be** at home now — «Dilnoza hozir uyda bo'lishi mumkin». Agar harakat aynan hozir davom etayotgan bo'lsa — **might be** + `-ing`: They **might be sleeping** — «Ular uxlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin». Bunday gaplarda o'zbekchada ham, inglizchada ham so'zlovchi aniq bilmaydi, faqat taxmin qiladi.

items.text: Aziz isn't here. He **might** be at the bank.
items.translation: Aziz bu yerda yo'q. U bankda **bo'lishi mumkin**.

items.text: Don't ring the bell — the baby **might** be sleeping.

blocks.text: Inkor shakli — **might not**: I **might not** go — «Bormasligim mumkin», «Balki bormasman». Qisqa shakl **mightn't** ham bor, lekin u kam ishlatiladi, ayniqsa yozuvda; **might not** ni tanlang. E'tibor bering: **might not** «aniq yo'q» degani emas, faqat «bo'lmasligi ham mumkin». Aniq inkor uchun **won't** (28-dars) yoki keyingi darsdagi **can't** ishlatiladi.

items.text: Bekzod **might not** come today. He's got a cold.
The museum **might not** be open in the evening.

blocks.text: Qanchalik aniq? will, going to, might

Kelajak haqida gapirganda fe'l tanlovi so'zlovchining qanchalik ishonchini ko'rsatadi. **will** va **won't** — so'zlovchi ishonadi (27–28-darslar). **going to** — qaror qilingan reja (26-dars). **might** — reja hali yo'q yoki natija noaniq. Shuning uchun «I'm going to go to London» — «Londonga boraman (rejalashtirdim)», «I **might** go to London» esa — «Balki Londonga borarman (hali qaror qilmadim)».

**might** bilan savol (Might you ...?) juda kam va eskicha eshitiladi. Odatda **Are you going to ...?** yoki **Will you ...?** deb so'raladi, javobda esa **might** keladi: Are you going to buy it? — I **might**. / I **might not**. Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi: «I might buy» emas, **I might**.

**may** ham xuddi shu ma'noni beradi: It **may** rain = It **might** rain — «Yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin». Farqi uslubda: **may** rasmiyroq, e'lonlar, ob-havo ma'lumoti, rasmiy xatlarda ko'p uchraydi; kundalik so'zlashuvda **might** ko'proq eshitiladi. Inkori — **may not** (qisqa shakli yo'q). Yana bir farq: **May I ...?** — xushmuomala ruxsat so'rash («...sam maylimi?»). Bu ma'noda **might** ishlatilmaydi. Ruxsat so'rashning boshqa yo'llari (Can I ...? Could I ...?) — 30-darsda.

items.text: Some trains **may** be cancelled because of the snow.
items.translation: Qor sababli ba'zi poyezdlar **bekor qilinishi mumkin**.

items.text: **May I** open the window? It's very hot in here.
items.translation: Derazani **ochsam maylimi**? Bu yer juda issiq.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I might to go.» → **I might go.** (`to` yo'q); «She mights come.» → **She might come.** (`-s` yo'q); «I don't might come.» → **I might not come.** (`do` kerak emas); «I might coming.» → **I might come.** yoki **I might be coming.**; «Maybe I might go.» — ikki marta «balki» bo'lib qoladi: **Maybe I'll go.** yoki **I might go.**

Eslab qolish: **might** = **maybe** + **will**. Maybe I'll stay at home = I **might** stay at home. Agar gapingizni «balki» bilan boshlamoqchi bo'lsangiz, uning o'rniga **might** ishlating — bu inglizchada tabiiyroq.

rows: He **might be working**. — U ishlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin.

examples.title: **might** + verb: maybe in the future
examples.description: Kelajakdagi aniq bo'lmagan reja yoki voqea: **might** + fe'l = «balki ...», «...ishi mumkin». Fe'l `to` siz, barcha egalar bilan `-s` siz.

sentences.text: I **might** visit my aunt in Samarkand this weekend.
sentences.translation: Bu dam olish kunlari **balki** Samarqanddagi xolamnikiga **borarman**.

sentences.text: We **might** buy a new car next year.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yili **balki** yangi mashina **olarmiz**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **might** study medicine at university.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza universitetda tibbiyotni **o'qishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Tom **might** join us for dinner, but he isn't sure yet.
sentences.translation: Tom biz bilan kechki ovqatga **qo'shilishi mumkin**, lekin u hali aniq bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Next summer my parents **might** move to a smaller flat.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yoz ota-onam kichikroq kvartiraga **ko'chishlari mumkin**.

sentences.text: Tonight I **might** watch a film, or I **might** just go to bed early.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **balki** film **ko'rarman**, balki shunchaki erta **yotarman**.

sentences.text: After college Aziz **might** get a job in his uncle's shop.
sentences.translation: Kollejni bitirgach, Aziz amakisining do'koniga ishga **kirishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The meeting **might** finish late, so I'll call you later.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish kech **tugashi mumkin**, shuning uchun senga keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

sentences.text: Sarah **might** change her job — she's tired of working at weekends.
sentences.translation: Sara ishini **almashtirishi mumkin** — u dam olish kunlari ishlashdan charchagan.

sentences.text: I'm not sure about my holiday yet: I **might** go to London, or I **might** stay at home.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilim haqida hali aniq bilmayman: **balki** Londonga **borarman**, balki uyda **qolarman**.

examples.title: **might be**: guessing about now
examples.description: **might** hozirgi holat haqidagi taxminni ham bildiradi: «hozir ... bo'lishi mumkin». Harakat aynan hozir davom etayotgan bo'lsa — **might be** + `-ing`.

sentences.text: Where's Bekzod? — He **might** be in the library.
sentences.translation: Bekzod qayerda? — Kutubxonada **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: It's late, so Emma **might** be asleep now.
sentences.translation: Kech bo'ldi, Emma hozir **uxlab qolgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: This answer **might** be wrong, so I'm going to check it again.
sentences.translation: Bu javob **noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin**, shuning uchun uni yana tekshirib chiqaman.

sentences.text: The keys **might** be in the car.
sentences.translation: Kalitlar mashinada **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Somebody is knocking at the door. It **might** be the postman.
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshikni taqillatyapti. Pochtachi **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Madina isn't answering her phone — she **might** be busy at work.
sentences.translation: Madina telefonini ko'tarmayapti — ishda **band bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: James **might** know the answer — he works in a bank.
sentences.translation: Jeyms javobni **bilishi mumkin** — u bankda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: I'm not sure, but this café **might** be closed on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Aniq bilmayman, lekin bu kafe yakshanba kunlari **yopiq bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The children are very quiet. They **might be watching** cartoons.
sentences.translation: Bolalar juda jim. Multfilm **ko'rayotgan bo'lishlari mumkin**.

sentences.text: That woman **might** be Aziz's sister — she looks just like him.
sentences.translation: Anavi ayol Azizning **opasi bo'lishi mumkin** — xuddi unga o'xshaydi.

examples.title: Negative: **might not**
examples.description: **might not** = «...-masligi mumkin», «balki ... -maydi». Inkor uchun `don't` kerak emas; qisqa shakl **mightn't** kam ishlatiladi.

sentences.text: I **might not** have time for lunch today.
sentences.translation: Bugun tushlikka **vaqtim bo'lmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The shop **might not** be open on a public holiday.
sentences.translation: Bayram kuni do'kon **ochiq bo'lmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **might not** play on Saturday — his leg still hurts.
sentences.translation: Bekzod shanba kuni **o'ynamasligi mumkin** — oyog'i hali ham og'riyapti.

sentences.text: I'm taking some cash — the taxi driver **might not** accept cards.
sentences.translation: Naqd pul olyapman — taksichi kartani **qabul qilmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We **might not** go to the mountains this weekend because the weather forecast is bad.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumoti yomon, shuning uchun bu dam olish kunlari tog'ga **bormasligimiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: Emma **might not** like this present, but I'm going to give it to her anyway.
sentences.translation: Bu sovg'a Emmaga **yoqmasligi mumkin**, lekin baribir unga beraman.

sentences.text: Sorry, that information **might not** be correct.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu ma'lumot **to'g'ri bo'lmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **might not** understand you — she doesn't speak English.
sentences.translation: Buvim sizni **tushunmasligi mumkin** — u inglizcha gapirmaydi.

sentences.text: In winter the trains to the mountains **might not** run every day.
sentences.translation: Qishda tog'larga poyezdlar har kuni **qatnamasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I **might** go to the gym tonight, or I **might not** — I'm really tired.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun sport zaliga **borarman**, balki **bormasman** — juda charchaganman.

examples.title: Reasons: because something **might** happen
examples.description: **might** ko'pincha ehtiyot chorasining sababini tushuntiradi: «... bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun ...». Bog'lovchilar: **because**, **so**.

sentences.text: My jacket is in my bag because it **might** get cold later.
sentences.translation: Kurtkam sumkamda, chunki keyinroq havo **sovib qolishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We're leaving early: the roads **might** be busy.
sentences.translation: Erta chiqyapmiz: yo'llar **tirband bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Aziz is booking a table now, because the restaurant **might** be full on Friday.
sentences.translation: Aziz hozir stol band qilyapti, chunki juma kuni restoran **to'la bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Your bag isn't safe here — somebody **might** take it.
sentences.translation: Sumkangiz bu yerda xavfsiz emas — kimdir **olib ketishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I'll write the address down for you — you **might** forget it.
sentences.translation: Manzilni sizga yozib beraman — **unutib qo'yishingiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: Sarah always carries medicine on long trips, because her son **might** feel sick.
sentences.translation: Sara uzoq safarlarda doim dori olib yuradi, chunki o'g'lining **ko'ngli aynishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The road **might** be icy this morning, so James is driving very slowly.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab yo'l **muz bo'lishi mumkin**, shuning uchun Jeyms juda sekin haydayapti.

sentences.text: My phone is charging now — I **might** need it on the way.
sentences.translation: Telefonim hozir quvvat olyapti — yo'lda **kerak bo'lib qolishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Madina is studying hard because the exam **might** be difficult.
sentences.translation: Madina qattiq tayyorlanyapti, chunki imtihon **qiyin bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Those mushrooms **might** be poisonous, so the children aren't eating them.
sentences.translation: U qo'ziqorinlar **zaharli bo'lishi mumkin**, shuning uchun bolalar ularni yemayapti.

examples.title: Questions and short answers: **I might.**
examples.description: **might** bilan savol kam beriladi: odatda Are you going to ...? / Will you ...? deb so'raladi. Javob — **I might.** («Balki») yoki **I might not.** («Balki yo'q»).

sentences.text: Are you going to the concert tonight? — I **might**.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun konsertga borasizmi? — **Balki**.

sentences.text: Will Tom be at the meeting? — He **might**, but he's very busy.
sentences.translation: Tom yig'ilishda bo'ladimi? — **Bo'lishi mumkin**, lekin u juda band.

sentences.text: Is it going to rain tomorrow? — It **might**. Look at those clouds.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yomg'ir yog'adimi? — **Yog'ishi mumkin**. Anavi bulutlarga qarang.

sentences.text: Do you think Dilnoza will win the competition? — She **might**.
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, Dilnoza musobaqada g'olib bo'ladimi? — **Balki**.

sentences.text: Are your parents coming to Tashkent for the holiday? — They **might not**. Dad has a lot of work.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz bayramga Toshkentga kelishadimi? — **Kelmasliklari mumkin**. Dadamning ishi ko'p.

sentences.text: Have you booked your summer holiday yet? — Not yet. We **might** go to Bukhara or Khiva.
sentences.translation: Yozgi ta'tilingizni band qildingizmi? — Hali yo'q. **Balki** Buxoro yoki Xivaga **borarmiz**.

sentences.text: When will the parcel arrive? — It **might** come on Monday.
sentences.translation: Posilka qachon keladi? — Dushanba kuni **kelishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Will you buy that jacket? — I **might not**. It's quite expensive.
sentences.translation: U kurtkani olasizmi? — **Olmasligim mumkin**. U ancha qimmat.

sentences.text: What's Emma doing? — She **might be cooking** dinner.
sentences.translation: Emma nima qilyapti? — Kechki ovqat **tayyorlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Who's that at the gate? — I don't know. It **might** be our new neighbour.
sentences.translation: Darvoza oldidagi kim? — Bilmadim. Yangi **qo'shnimiz bo'lishi mumkin**.

examples.title: **will**, **might** or **won't**: how sure are you?
examples.description: Ishonch darajasi: **will** — aniq, **might** — balki, **might not** — balki yo'q, **won't** — aniq yo'q. Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon.

sentences.text: I**'ll** be at home this evening, but I **might** go out later.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun uyda **bo'laman**, lekin keyinroq **chiqib ketishim mumkin**.

sentences.text: Aziz **will** definitely pass the exam — he studies every day.
sentences.translation: Aziz imtihondan **albatta o'tadi** — u har kuni o'qiydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **might** pass, but he **might not** — he didn't study much.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **o'tishi ham mumkin**, **o'tmasligi ham mumkin** — u ko'p o'qimadi.

sentences.text: We have plenty of time, so we **won't** be late.
sentences.translation: Vaqtimiz ko'p, shuning uchun **kechikmaymiz**.

sentences.text: It's already ten past seven: we **might** miss the train.
sentences.translation: Soat yettidan o'n daqiqa o'tdi: poyezdga **ulgurmasligimiz mumkin**.

sentences.text: Sarah **won't** come today, but she **might** come tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Sara bugun **kelmaydi**, lekin ertaga **kelishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I'm sure the shop **will** be open — it's open every day until ten.
sentences.translation: Do'kon **ochiq bo'lishiga** aminman — u har kuni soat o'ngacha ochiq.

sentences.text: My brother **won't** lend me his car, but my sister **might**.
sentences.translation: Akam menga mashinasini **bermaydi**, lekin opam **berishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The doctor says Grandad **will** feel better soon, but he **might** need more rest.
sentences.translation: Shifokorning aytishicha, bobom tez orada **tuzalib ketadi**, lekin unga ko'proq dam olish **kerak bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, I **won't** forget your birthday — but I **might** forget the cake!
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, tug'ilgan kuningizni **unutmayman** — lekin tortni **unutib qo'yishim mumkin**!

examples.title: **may** and **may not**; **May I ...?**
examples.description: **may** — might bilan bir xil ma'no, lekin rasmiyroq: e'lon, ob-havo ma'lumoti, rasmiy matn. **May I ...?** — xushmuomala ruxsat so'rash («...sam maylimi?»).

sentences.text: The flight **may** be delayed because of the fog.
sentences.translation: Tuman sababli reys **kechikishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Prices **may** change without notice.
sentences.translation: Narxlar oldindan ogohlantirmasdan **o'zgarishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: **May I** use your phone for a minute?
sentences.translation: Telefoningizdan bir daqiqaga **foydalansam maylimi**?

sentences.text: Some students **may not** agree with this idea.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi talabalar bu fikrga **qo'shilmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **may I** sit here? — Yes, of course.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, shu yerga **o'tirsam maylimi**? — Ha, albatta.

sentences.text: On Thursday the weather **may** turn cold in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni tog'larda havo **sovib ketishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Our teacher **may** give us a test on Friday — nobody knows yet.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz juma kuni test **olishi mumkin** — hali hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: This medicine **may** make you feel sleepy.
sentences.translation: Bu dori **uyqungizni keltirishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: James **may** be late tonight; his train left Oxford an hour late.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bugun kechqurun **kechikishi mumkin**: poyezdi Oksforddan bir soat kech jo'nadi.

sentences.text: **May I** ask you a question, Mr Brown? — Of course, go ahead.
sentences.translation: Savol **bersam maylimi**, janob Braun? — Albatta, so'rang.

examples.title: Dialogue: plans for Saturday
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st dam olish rejasini muhokama qiladi — **might**, **might not**, **may** va **will**.

sentences.text: — Tom, I **might** go to the new shopping centre on Saturday. Do you want to come?
sentences.translation: — Tom, shanba kuni yangi savdo markaziga **borishim mumkin**. Birga borasanmi?

sentences.text: — I'm not sure. My cousins **might** visit us this weekend.
sentences.translation: — Bilmadim. Bu dam olish kunlari amakivachchalarim bizga **kelishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — Oh, and when **will** you know?
sentences.translation: — Voy, qachon **bilasan**?

sentences.text: — Tonight, probably. They **might** call after dinner.
sentences.translation: — Ehtimol, bugun kechqurun. Kechki ovqatdan keyin **qo'ng'iroq qilishlari mumkin**.

sentences.text: — OK. The shops **might** be very busy on Saturday anyway.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Baribir shanba kuni do'konlar juda **gavjum bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — That's true. Sunday **might** be a better day for me.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Men uchun yakshanba **qulayroq bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — I **might not** be free on Sunday morning. Grandma is coming to lunch.
sentences.translation: — Yakshanba ertalab **bo'sh bo'lmasligim mumkin**. Buvim tushlikka kelyaptilar.

sentences.text: — Then we **may** go in the afternoon. How about three o'clock?
sentences.translation: — Unda tushdan keyin **borishimiz mumkin**. Soat uchda qalay?

sentences.text: — Three is fine. I**'ll** send you a message on Saturday evening.
sentences.translation: — Soat uch bo'ladi. Shanba kechqurun senga **xabar yozaman**.

sentences.text: — Great! And bring your brother — he **might** like the new games shop.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Ukangni ham olib kel — yangi o'yinlar do'koni unga **yoqishi mumkin**.
